name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Infused Preroll | Super Lemon Haze
description:
Built for energy and impact, this 1.2G infused pre-roll combines premium sativa flower with terpene-rich live resin for amplified potency and loud citrus expression. Designed for daytime smokers and high-tolerance consumers chasing flavor and lift.

Strain: Super Lemon Haze (Sativa)

Infusion: Full-spectrum Live Resin

Total Weight: 1.2g

Aroma: Sharp lemon zest, sweet citrus candy, light herbal haze

Flavor: Bright lemon peel upfront with sugary citrus and subtle diesel on the finish

Effects: Fast-acting cerebral surge, energetic uplift, creative focus

Experience: Thick smoke output, slow even burn, intensified terp profile
